paths.description: Homepage and discovery hub; represents global navigation, age gate, content feed, preferences, network and rendering.
Category index; represents the taxonomy/listing template.
Gallery listing and search; represents content listing, filtering and search controls.
Video listing; represents media listings and late-loading layout.
Sign-in journey; represents account forms, input assistance, validation and recovery.

findings.summary: The interface is hard-coded for a light colour scheme.
findings.evidence: Under emulated dark preference, `color-scheme` remained `normal`, body text remained black, no relevant preference rules were found, and the dark capture remained light.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare `color-scheme: light dark` and use `prefers-color-scheme` or `light-dark()` for surfaces and controls.

findings.summary: Text and essential controls do not consistently meet contrast requirements.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed the color-contrast audit; no `prefers-contrast` or forced-colors adaptation was found.
findings.suggestedFix: Correct failing colour pairs and add forced-colors/high-contrast-safe control styling.

findings.summary: Navigation swaps are abrupt and do not preserve visual continuity.
findings.evidence: Recon shows a multi-page set of ordinary links; no active transition was observed and no View Transition integration was established for route changes.
findings.suggestedFix: Add cross-document view transitions for same-origin template navigation, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: Long listing pages provide little position-aware navigation guidance.
findings.evidence: Mobile content height reached 7,140 CSS px while the DOM/CSS probes found no verified sticky progress, scroll-state chrome, or equivalent position cue.
findings.suggestedFix: Add restrained sticky navigation or a scroll-position/progress affordance that does not obscure content.

findings.summary: The mandatory age gate is implemented as a custom top-layer div rather than a semantic dialog.
findings.evidence: The overlay probe found `#agego-overlay-container` covering 780x493 at z-index 2147483647; the page contains zero `<dialog>` and zero popover elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Implement the age confirmation as a modal `<dialog>` with focus containment, an accessible name, and explicit confirmation action.

findings.summary: Mobile browsers receive a scaled-down desktop layout instead of a responsive layout.
findings.evidence: All four tested templates lacked a viewport meta tag. At a requested 360px viewport, home rendered a 1,292px layout viewport and login/video rendered 1,000px layouts.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a standard viewport meta tag, replace fixed desktop widths with intrinsic/fluid layout, and test each template at narrow widths.

findings.summary: Touch and form controls are too small and many controls lack usable labels.
findings.evidence: On login, 38 of 44 visible interactive elements were under 24px in at least one dimension and ten text/password controls were unlabeled. Lighthouse also failed target-size.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide at least 24x24 CSS px targets (prefer 44x44 for primary controls), spacing, persistent labels, and visible `:focus-visible` styling.

findings.summary: Sign-in does not expose native required state or accessible recovery feedback before submission.
findings.evidence: Username/password were not `required`, empty submission produced no `:invalid` controls, and the page had no live region, alert, or status element.
findings.suggestedFix: Use native constraints, validate after interaction, focus a summary on failure, and announce field errors through `aria-live`/`role=alert`.

findings.summary: Measured mobile loading is slow.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 8.28s, FCP 4.47s and TTI 8.30s (performance score 0.61), despite a separate warm trace showing no long tasks.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP asset, defer non-critical ads/scripts, and establish field CWV monitoring.

findings.summary: The homepage transfers excessive image weight and blocks rendering on legacy resources.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 146 requests and 11.72MB transferred, including two GIF thumbnails of 5.19MB and 4.70MB. Parser-inserted classic scripts lacked async/defer and CSS was uncompressed/uncached.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace animated GIFs with modern video/image formats, lazy-load below-fold media, set cache/compression headers, and defer non-critical classic scripts.

findings.summary: Core controls and media lack accessible names.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed image-alt, label and link-name. The image probe found 48 images without alt and the login probe found ten unlabeled text/password controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate text alternatives, programmatic labels, and discernible names for image links and controls.

findings.summary: Pages lack semantic landmarks and a consistent heading hierarchy.
findings.evidence: The login page had no main/nav/header/footer landmarks, no H1, and only an H2, although browser-default focus outline was visible.
findings.suggestedFix: Use semantic landmarks, one clear page H1, ordered headings, and preserve visible focus through overlays.

findings.summary: Zoom/reflow and mobile target requirements are not met.
findings.evidence: No viewport meta was present and Lighthouse failed meta-viewport and target-size; tested mobile pages rendered at 1,000-1,292 CSS px rather than 360px.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide a scalable viewport, responsive reflow, larger targets, and captions/equivalents for any user-uploaded video where available.

findings.summary: Images are frequently unsized, distorted, and served without responsive variants.
findings.evidence: Image audit found 79/100 missing dimensions, 58 missing srcset, 98 legacy-format images, and Lighthouse failed image aspect ratio/responsive sizing.
findings.suggestedFix: Set intrinsic dimensions/aspect-ratio and provide responsive modern-format sources.

findings.summary: The page has browser hygiene issues despite avoiding console exceptions.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported DevTools inspector issues and 1.35s potential unused-JS savings; the DOM had 92 inline event-handler elements and 16 target=_blank links without noopener/noreferrer.
findings.suggestedFix: Resolve Inspector issues, remove stale inline wiring, trim legacy/unused JS, and add safe external-link rel values.

findings.summary: Search metadata is incomplete across public templates.
findings.evidence: Raw HTML is crawlable (92% coverage), but no viewport meta exists, multiple links have no discernible name, no canonical was present, sitemap.xml returned 404, and no JSON-LD/Open Graph metadata was found.
findings.suggestedFix: Add viewport and descriptive link names, canonical URLs, a sitemap, and accurate Open Graph/structured metadata for gallery/media entities.

findings.summary: Session and analytics cookies are not protected and key browser security headers are absent.
findings.evidence: All seven cookies lacked Secure; PHPSESSID also lacked HttpOnly and SameSite protection. CSP, frame protection, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy were absent.
findings.suggestedFix: Mark session cookies Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite=Lax/Strict; deploy an enforcing CSP plus frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: The first page load exposes users to a large advertising and analytics footprint.
findings.evidence: Tracker probe found 18 third-party origins and Google Analytics/Tag Manager/DoubleClick; HAR attributed 121/146 requests and 11.52MB to non-main-origin hosts.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimise vendors, gate non-essential analytics/ads on informed consent, proxy or self-host necessary assets, and shorten retention.

findings.summary: Authentication is password-only and lacks modern input assistance.
findings.evidence: The login template contains username/password fields, no WebAuthn/passkey affordance, and blank autocomplete attributes.
findings.suggestedFix: Add passkey sign-in/registration and correct `autocomplete="username"` and `autocomplete="current-password"` fallback tokens.

findings.summary: Representative error and failure states are not actionable or accessible.
findings.evidence: Empty login submission exposed no native invalid state or live feedback; HAR also recorded blocked/aborted ad and image requests without an observed user-facing recovery state.
findings.suggestedFix: Design explicit inline and summary errors, retry affordances, and graceful placeholders for failed media/network requests.

findings.summary: Rendered dates are not demonstrably locale-aware.
findings.evidence: The English page rendered a fixed English date while probes found no alternate locale surface or evidence that user-facing date formatting responds to locale.
findings.suggestedFix: Format dates/numbers with `Intl` and keep stored timestamps unambiguous.

findings.summary: Advertising competes with account tasks and is not always clearly distinguishable from site content.
findings.evidence: The login DOM included locally personalised promotional copy linking back to the login URL, while the homepage loaded several ad networks and three visible ad-like regions.
findings.suggestedFix: Clearly label and visually separate ads, remove misleading self-links, and keep account actions dominant.

findings.summary: Forms neither prevent nor explain common mistakes humanely.
findings.evidence: Login fields are not required and empty submission yielded no invalid controls or live error region.
findings.suggestedFix: Use post-interaction native validation, specific field messages, an accessible error summary, and non-destructive retry.

findings.summary: Sign-in fields omit autofill tokens.
findings.evidence: Both username and password reported an empty autocomplete value.
findings.suggestedFix: Set `autocomplete="username"` and `autocomplete="current-password"`; preserve password-manager and paste support.

findings.summary: Media delivery is disproportionately wasteful even for an image-heavy service.
findings.evidence: The homepage transferred 11.72MB, 11.23MB as images; 88 below-fold images were not lazy-loaded, 98/100 used legacy formats, and two GIF thumbnails accounted for 9.88MB.
findings.suggestedFix: Transcode animated thumbnails, serve responsive AVIF/WebP, lazy-load below-fold content, and budget each feed page.

findings.summary: Non-essential third-party work begins immediately on load.
findings.evidence: The network capture started analytics, ad, age-verification and related requests during initial rendering, contributing 121 non-main-origin requests.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer and batch non-essential work until consent, visibility, or interaction; remove duplicate ad/analytics loaders.
